title: DiscordBoostRank
description:
Automatically checks whether a player has boosted the Discord server
Automatically gives rewards when a player boosts the server
body:
### DiscordBoostRank – Features
- ### Automatically checks whether a player has boosted the Discord server
- 
- Automatically reminds players if they have not linked their account
- 
- Automatically sends notifications when a player starts boosting or when their boost expires (to the admin channel and to the player)
- 
- Automatically assigns a rank (if the group already exists in LuckPerms) or automatically creates the rank if it does not exist
- 
- Automatically backs up and synchronizes data periodically
- 
- Automatically gives rewards when a player boosts the server
- 
- Automatically generates statistics
### Commands
- /bra reload – Reload the configuration
- 
- /bra check <player> – Check a player's boost information
- 
- /bra sync – Synchronize data
- 
- /bra clearcache <player> – Clear/reset a player's data
- 
- /bra stats – View statistics
- 
- /bra backup – Back up data
### Requirements
- ### Java 17+
- 
- DiscordSRV installed
- 
- LuckPerms installed
- 
- Bukkit/Paper server 1.16+
-
